_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: John Dryden (1631-1700) as translator. Each TITLE is its own work with its own slug (dryden-aeneid, dryden-georgics ...); author sections (Virgil, Ovid, Juvenal ...) cross-reference these slugs, never a second copy. SOURCES are the files fetched (fetch_shelf.py); TITLES are cut from them by heading marker (split_shelf_titles.py). Clean text: Project Gutenberg's transcription of Scott's edition, The Works of John Dryden (18 vols, 1808; PG's volumes are the 1821 2nd ed. reprint), plus PG 228 (Aeneid). Raw OCR (Internet Archive): the Garth composite Metamorphoses and the 1684 History of the League, neither on Gutenberg. All PD (Dryden d. 1700; Scott d. 1832). No uids minted in the relay burst: every title awaits Adam's single-writer minting pass.

dryden-scott-11: Works of John Dryden (Scott), vol. 11: Fables (Chaucer, Boccace); Veni Creator
dryden-scott-12: Works of John Dryden (Scott), vol. 12: Ovid, Theocritus, Lucretius, Horace, Homer
dryden-scott-13: Works of John Dryden (Scott), vol. 13: Juvenal, Persius, Virgil's Pastorals
dryden-scott-14: Works of John Dryden (Scott), vol. 14: Georgics, Aeneis I-VII with the Dedication
dryden-scott-15: Works of John Dryden (Scott), vol. 15: Aeneis VIII-XII, Postscript
dryden-scott-16: Works of John Dryden (Scott), vol. 16: Life of St Francis Xavier (from Bouhours)
dryden-scott-17: Works of John Dryden (Scott), vol. 17: Du Fresnoy, Art of Painting

dryden-garth-metamorphoses-1826: Ovid's Metamorphoses, tr. Garth, Dryden, Addison et al. (1826 reprint of the Garth 1717 edition)
dryden-league-1684: Maimbourg, The History of the League, tr. Dryden (1684)

dryden-aeneid.note: PG 228. Scott vols 14-15 carry the same translation with Dryden's Dedication and Notes (also shelved as sources).
dryden-aeneid.held_note: adler_shelf.json titles PG 228 'Eclogues, Georgics, Aeneid'; the file holds the Aeneid only (12 books; this shelf's cut of it found no Eclogues or Georgics). Dryden's Eclogues and Georgics come from Scott vols 13-14 here. The adler title is not lane C's file to edit: reported in REPORT-C/DIGEST-C.

dryden-aeneid-dedication.work: Dedication of the Aeneis (Dryden's own essay, prefixed to the translation)
dryden-aeneid-dedication.note: Dryden's prose, not a translation; kept because PG 228 omits it and the Aeneid is cited with it.

dryden-georgics.work: Georgics, 4 books (with Dedication and Addison's Essay)

dryden-eclogues.work: Eclogues (Pastorals) I-X, with Dedication and Walsh's Preface

dryden-metamorphoses.work: Metamorphoses, 15 books, the Garth composite edition
dryden-metamorphoses.note: MANY HANDS: Dryden's share is Book I, Book XII and the Fables episodes; the rest is Addison, Gay, Garth, Congreve, Rowe, Pope, Tate, Croxall et al. Raw OCR, unproofread. Dryden's own share in clean text is dryden-ovid-metamorphoses.
dryden-metamorphoses.translator: Garth ed.: John Dryden, Joseph Addison, John Gay, Samuel Garth, William Congreve, Nicholas Rowe, Alexander Pope, Nahum Tate, Samuel Croxall et al.
dryden-metamorphoses.overlap: Dryden's own Books I and XII and episodes appear BOTH here and in dryden-ovid-metamorphoses (Scott vol. 12): two witnesses of the same translation, one uid per passage at minting.

dryden-ovid-metamorphoses.work: Metamorphoses: Dryden's own translations (Book I, Book XII, Ajax and Ulysses, Pythagorean Philosophy and 9 episodes)
dryden-ovid-metamorphoses.overlap: Same passages as Dryden's share of dryden-metamorphoses (Garth): two witnesses.

dryden-ovid-epistles.work: Heroides (Ovid's Epistles): Canace, Helen, Dido, with Dryden's Preface

dryden-lucretius.work: De Rerum Natura: selections from Books I-V

dryden-iliad.work: Iliad Book I; Hector and Andromache (Book VI)

dryden-juvenal.work: Satires I, III, VI, X, XVI, with the Discourse on Satire

dryden-fables-chaucer.work: Fables: Palamon and Arcite, Cock and Fox, Flower and Leaf, Wife of Bath, Good Parson (with the Preface to the Fables)
dryden-fables-chaucer.note: Modernisations of Middle English, not translations from another language; part of Fables Ancient and Modern. Chaucer's originals are in Scott vol. 12's appendix (not cut).

dryden-fables-boccaccio.work: Fables: Sigismonda and Guiscardo, Theodore and Honoria, Cymon and Iphigenia
dryden-fables-boccaccio.note: Scott subjoins each Decameron original after the verse; the span includes those.

dryden-xavier.work: The Life of St Francis Xavier (French prose)

dryden-art-of-painting.work: De Arte Graphica (The Art of Painting), with the Parallel of Poetry and Painting

dryden-history-of-the-league.work: The History of the League (French prose), complete
dryden-history-of-the-league.note: Raw OCR of the 1684 first edition (long s). Scott vol. 17 prints only a specimen (Book III).

_pending.dryden-fables-1700: Fables Ancient and Modern, first edition 1700 (IA mdu-rare-075246; bim_early-english-books-1641-1700_fables-ancient-and-moder_dryden-john_1700): the book as Dryden ordered it. Scott's text covers every piece; the 1700 OCR is wanted only to reconstruct the original order.
_pending.dryden-virgil-1697: The Works of Virgil, 1697 folio (later editions on IA, e.g. worksvirgilcont00drydgoog 1721, worksofvirgil00virguoft 1800). Scott covers all of it clean.
_pending.dryden-juvenal-1693: The Satires of Juvenalis ... by Mr. Dryden and several other eminent hands, 1693 (IA juvenaldrydensatires): the whole book incl. the other translators' satires (II, IV, V, VII-IX, XI-XV by Congreve, Tate, Creech et al.). Scott prints only Dryden's five.
_pending.dryden-garth-metamorphoses-1717: Garth's first edition, 1717 (IA bim_eighteenth-century_ovids-metamorphoses-in-_ovid_1717): long-s OCR; the 1826 reprint was preferred.
_pending.dryden-xavier-1688: Life of St Francis Xavier, 1688 first edition (IA gpl_1784827). Scott vol. 16 covers it clean.
_pending.dryden-scott-saintsbury: Scott-Saintsbury revised edition (1882-93, 18 vols; IA cu31924016650305 etc.): later notes; same Dryden text.

_excluded.dryden-plutarch: 'Plutarch's Lives, the Dryden translation' (1683-86; Clough revision 1859) was by 41 hands; Scott vol. 17 quotes Malone: 'Dryden translated none of the Lives.' Dryden wrote only the Dedication and Life of Plutarch (original prose). Not a Dryden translation.
_excluded.dryden-polybius-lucian: The Character of Polybius and The Life of Lucian (Scott vol. 18) are Dryden's prefaces to other men's translations. Not translations.
_excluded.dryden-other-ovid-virgil: Non-Dryden translations of Ovid and Virgil belong to lane B's author sections, never this shelf.
_excluded.pg-24901: Speech by John Fairfield Dryden (1839-1911), US senator: wrong Dryden.
_excluded.gilfillan-poetical-works: PG 11488/11578 (Gilfillan ed., 1855): original poems + Fables; duplicates Scott, fewer translations. Not fetched.
_excluded.pg-7490: Dryden's Palamon and Arcite (PG 7490, school ed.): same text as dryden-fables-chaucer. Duplicate.
_excluded.scott-vol-league-specimen: Scott vol. 17's History of the League specimen (Book III only): superseded by the complete 1684 OCR.

_name_words_note: Translator name(s) only: fetch_shelf.py treats these as the identity check (one must appear in the fetched text), so the original author's name is deliberately NOT listed.
_verified_note: Evidence that each source's rights/identity line was read (lane C review fix, 2026-10-02, pipeline run over the fetched files; no book text recorded). PG: the header's Translator: line and the COPYRIGHTED marker. IA: whether the translator's name appears in the first 30 KB of OCR, and the years printed in the first 15 KB of front matter (scanner/digitizer lines skipped). Any post-1930 year there was examined by eye; see the title's scan_edition.
